root_idea.summary: The root centers on turning aside from a straight or central line.
root_idea.development: This orientation appears physically in the lateral recess of a grave, semantically in deviation from truth or proper conduct, and in turning aside toward a place of refuge. These developments describe the root's semantic orientation rather than meanings of every derived form.

senses.definition: To deviate from the right or from truth; in Quranic usage, to distort or improperly interpret what should be held rightly.
senses.usage_conditions: Used with فِي in applications involving religion, divine names, or revealed signs. The expressions concerning deviation in God's names and distortion of His signs belong to this sense.

senses.definition: To incline toward someone as a referent or source.
senses.usage_conditions: In the construction يُلْحِدُونَ إِلَيْهِ, إِلَى identifies the person toward whom they incline or to whom they refer. A Form I reading of the same passage is also reported, but the QAC occurrence is grouped here under Form IV.

senses.definition: Wrongful deviation or violation in the Sacred Mosque or its sacred territory.
senses.usage_conditions: In 22:25, the noun concerns departing from commanded right conduct there, committing injustice or desecration, and related forms of impious violation. Explanations also include opposing others, associating partners with God, doubting God, and, as a reported application, hoarding provisions in the sanctuary. The Quran-focused classification distinguishes association with God from attributing independent efficacy to created causes; the former invalidates faith, while the latter weakens it without nullifying it.

senses.definition: A refuge, asylum, or place of recourse to which one turns for protection or concealment.
senses.usage_conditions: The passive participle is substantivized as a place of refuge or recourse; it can include a place sought for lodging or protection.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To decline or deviate from the straight course, or to incline toward someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: With إِلَى, the verb denotes inclination toward a person or thing; with فِي الدِّينِ, it denotes deviation from the right way or impugning religion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a lateral recess in a grave and, for a corpse, to place or bury it in that recess.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may describe digging the recess for the corpse or putting the corpse into it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A lateral hollow or oblong excavation in the side of a grave, where the corpse is placed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: لُحْدٌ and لَحَدٌ are reported as variant forms of this noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To behave toward another in a crooked or perverse manner, with the other behaving likewise.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the reciprocal Form III construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To dispute, wrangle, or engage in altercation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a reported interpersonal use of Form IV.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bring reproach upon someone, despise or disparage him, or say something false about him; also to disparage his clemency or intellect.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction أَلْحَدَ بِهِ carries the interpersonal sense of reproach or disparagement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To turn or have recourse to someone or something for refuge, protection, concealment, or lodging.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Typically constructed with إِلَى; the action is understood as turning aside toward the sought refuge.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who deviates from truth and introduces into it what does not belong to it; an impugner of religion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In a specialized historical usage, the plural appellation may be applied especially to Bāṭinī groups said to reinterpret the Quran through an inward doctrine that departs from its outward sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A grave lahd, understood as the place into which the corpse is put.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a place-noun use distinct from مُلْتَحَد, the refuge or place of recourse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A grave in which a lateral lahd has been made.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: مُلْحَدٌ and لَاحِدٌ are cross-referenced with this grave-related lexical use in the classical material.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of an arrow, to veer to one side of the target.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a physical-direction use of Form IV, distinct from religious deviation.
